summary_md: **Sanem Avcil ([@SanemBuilds](https://x.com/SanemBuilds/status/2116664234973266149))** credits LucasJRamos for **SpriteKiln**, which turns YAML-defined 3D characters into animated 8-direction pixel-art sprites for Godot 4, Unity and MonoGame, designed to be driven by coding agents without a GPU or Blender ([LucasJRamos/spritekiln](https://github.com/LucasJRamos/spritekiln)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - LucasJRamos/spritekiln: Animated pixel-art sprites (8-direction top-down or side view) from procedural 3D models in YAML, built to be driven by coding AIs. Exports to Godot, Unity, MonoGame or any engine.
